# Design System: By Jawad — Mission Control Monochrome

**Owner:** Jawad Jalal · Portfolio & Landing Page Specialist  
**Version:** mission-control-monochrome-v2 · **Project ID:** `13841983534348291374`  
**Canonical repo doc:** `docs/design-token-system.md`  
**Visual proof:** `docs/design-token-showcase-v2.html`

**Brand:** Editorial black-and-white core + cyan mission telemetry + gold launch CTAs.  
**3-second emotion:** *"This person is operating at a different level."*  
**Business goal:** Book a Call · Start an Inquiry

---

## 1. Design philosophy

### 1.1 Accent budget (locked)

| Tier | Share | Tokens | Use on | Never use on |
|------|-------|--------|--------|--------------|
| **Ink** | ~85% | ink, neutral, surface, text | Backgrounds, H1–H4, body, nav text, secondary/ghost CTAs, white halftone | — |
| **Spectral** | ~10% | spectral.* | Kickers, active nav underline, focus rings, stat values, card hover border, hero L2 atmosphere | Body copy, headlines, CTA fill |
| **Flare** | ~5% | flare.* | Primary CTA fill only | Kickers, links, headings, decorative blocks |

Semantic colors (success, error, warning, info) are **forms and system feedback only**.

### 1.2 Visual north star

Swiss poster restraint on a **pure black canvas** (`#000000`). Mission-control telemetry reads through **cyan mono kickers** and **stat numerals**. Conversion moments use **gold buttons** with black labels. Depth from **halftone dots**, **film grain**, and **layered neutral surfaces** — not nebula gradients or violet SaaS chrome.

### 1.3 Motion (hard rules)

- Animate **only** `transform` and `opacity`
- Never `transition-all`
- Hover: `duration-150` · Enter: `duration-300` · Easing: see frontmatter `motion`
- Honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (disable parallax, orbit, marquee)

---

## 2. Color system

### 2.1 Ink & surfaces

| Token | Hex | Role |
|-------|-----|------|
| ink-white | `#FAFAFA` | Primary text, nav links (hover/active), secondary emphasis |
| ink-black | `#000000` | Canvas, CTA label on gold |
| surface-base | `#000000` | Page background (always — not `#131313`) |
| surface-elevated | `#0A0A0A` | Cards, inputs, tool tiles |
| surface-floating | `#141414` | Final CTA band, mobile menu |
| surface-overlay | `rgba(0,0,0,0.72)` | Scrolled nav + backdrop |
| border-subtle | `#262626` | Card/section borders |
| border-default | `#404040` | Inputs, ghost/outline buttons |

### 2.2 Text hierarchy

| Token | Hex | Role |
|-------|-----|------|
| text-primary | `#FAFAFA` | Headlines, primary body on dark |
| text-secondary | `#A3A3A3` | Subheads, supporting copy |
| text-muted | `#737373` | Footer links default, tertiary |
| text-inverse | `#000000` | Label on flare CTA |

### 2.3 Spectral (telemetry)

| Token | Hex / value | Role |
|-------|-------------|------|
| spectral-400 | `#67E8F9` | Telemetry hover |
| spectral-500 | `#22D3EE` | Kickers, active nav underline, stat values, focus ring |
| spectral-600 | `#06B6D4` | Pressed telemetry |
| spectral-glow | `rgba(34,211,238,0.25)` | Hero atmosphere, card hover glow |
| spectral-border | `rgba(34,211,238,0.15)` | Mission card hover border |

### 2.4 Flare (launch CTA only)

| Token | Hex | Role |
|-------|-----|------|
| flare-400 | `#FCD34D` | Primary CTA hover |
| flare-500 | `#FBBF24` | Primary CTA fill |
| flare-600 | `#F59E0B` | Primary CTA active |
| flare-label | `#000000` | CTA text on gold |

**Primary button states:**

| State | Fill | Text | Other |
|-------|------|------|-------|
| Default | flare-500 | flare-label | radius 8px |
| Hover | flare-400 | flare-label | translateY(-1px) |
| Active | flare-600 | flare-label | translateY(0) |
| Focus-visible | flare-500 | flare-label | 2px spectral-500 outline, 2px offset |

WCAG: `#FBBF24` on `#000000` passes AA for UI components.

### 2.5 Semantic (forms only)

| error-500 | `#F87171` | Validation errors |
| warning-500 | `#FBBF24` | Alerts (not CTA) |
| info-500 | `#60A5FA` | Tooltips |

## 3. Typography

### 3.1 Font stacks

| Role | Family | Usage |
|------|--------|-------|
| Display | Space Grotesk | H1–H4, nav, CTA labels, section titles |
| Body | Inter | Paragraphs, forms, FAQ |
| Mono | JetBrains Mono | Kickers (spectral), stats, day labels, metadata |

**Never use:** Syne, DM Sans, Instrument Serif, Inter for headlines, colored headline gradients.

### 3.2 Type scale

| Token | Size | Weight | Line-height | Letter-spacing | Color |
|-------|------|--------|-------------|----------------|-------|
| display | clamp(3rem, 8vw, 6rem) | 800 | 1.0 | -0.025em | text-primary |
| h1 | clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) | 700 | 1.05 | -0.02em | text-primary |
| h2 | clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem) | 700 | 1.1 | -0.015em | text-primary |
| h3 | 36px | 600 | 1.15 | -0.01em | text-primary |
| h4 | 24px | 600 | 1.25 | 0 | text-primary |
| body-lg | 20px | 400 | 1.5 | 0 | text-secondary |
| body | 16px | 400 | 1.5 | 0 | text-secondary |
| small | 14px | 400 | 1.4 | 0 | text-secondary |
| caption | 12px | 500 | 1.4 | 0.02em | text-muted |
| kicker-mono | 12px | 500 | 1.4 | 0.12em uppercase | **spectral-500** |
| stat-value-mono | 24px | 500 | 1.2 | 0 | **spectral-500** |
| stat-label-mono | 12px | 500 | 1.4 | 0.12em uppercase | neutral-400 |

### 3.3 Typography specimens (reference copy)

**Display:** Landing pages.  
**H1:** Out of this world.  
**H2:** Featured missions  
**Kicker (cyan):** ORBIT-READY WEB DESIGN  
**Body-lg:** I design and build high-converting landing pages, portfolio websites, and modern web experiences for brands and creators.  
**Stat:** `24h` (cyan) / `RESPONSE WINDOW` (gray mono)

### 3.4 Pairing rules

- One kicker (cyan mono) above each section H2 — never skip on major sections
- Max body width ~65ch (`max-w-2xl`) for long copy
- Nav links stay gray default → white hover — **not** cyan link text

---

**Homepage section order (locked):** `nav → hero → trust → work → process → tools → cta → footer`

Anchors: `#hero` `#trust` `#work` `#process` `#tools` `#cta`

---

## 5. Elevation, radius & shadows

### 5.1 Surfaces (no Material gray drift)

Use only `#000000`, `#0A0A0A`, `#141414` for marketing surfaces — never `#131313` or `#1f1f1f` Material containers.

### 5.2 Shadows (black-alpha only)

| Token | Use |
|-------|-----|
| shadow-1 | Cards at rest |
| shadow-2 | Cards hover, dropdowns |
| shadow-3 | Modals |
| shadow-4 | Toasts |
| glow-telemetry | Mission card hover (optional, with spectral border) |

### 5.3 Border radius

| Token | px | Use |
|-------|-----|-----|
| none | 0 | Full-bleed images |
| sm | 4 | Inputs |
| md | 8 | Buttons |
| lg | 12 | Cards |
| xl | 16 | Large cards |
| 2xl | 24 | Feature bands |
| full | 999 | Pills, badges |

---

## 6. Halftone, grain & atmosphere

### 6.1 Film grain (global)

- SVG fractal noise at **3% opacity** (`effect.grain`)
- Fixed overlay, `pointer-events: none`, full viewport

### 6.2 Halftone patterns

| Variant | Pitch | Fill | Opacity | Blend | Placement |
|---------|-------|------|---------|-------|-----------|
| halftone | 6px | white | 10% | overlay | Card corners, section edges |
| halftone-hero | 8px | white | 12% | overlay | Hero edges (non-spaceman side OK) |
| halftone-spectral | 8px | `#22D3EE` | 8% | overlay | **Hero right edge only** (spaceman side) |
| halftone-image | 6px | white | 10–15% | soft-light | Thumbnail overlays |

**SVG reference (white dots):**

```svg
<pattern id="halftone" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
  <circle cx="3" cy="3" r="1.2" fill="white"/>
</pattern>
```

### 6.3 Hero atmosphere (L2 only)

Stack on hero scrim layer — not full-site background:

```css
background:
  radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 50% at 85% 15%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.04), transparent),
  radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 15% 50%, rgba(250, 250, 250, 0.02), transparent);
```

Optional left scrim for readability: `linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.35) 0%, transparent 55%)`

### 6.4 Image treatment

- Project thumbnails: grayscale default, `effect.image-overlay` gradient to top
- Halftone overlay on images for editorial texture

## 10. Anti-patterns (hard bans)

| Ban | Reason |
|-----|--------|
| Indigo/violet/blue Tailwind defaults | Not on-brand |
| Cyan/purple gradient headlines | Headlines stay white |
| Spectral on body or H1–H4 | Telemetry tier only |
| Gold on kickers, links, headings | Flare = primary CTA only |
| `#131313` / Material surface grays | Canvas is `#000000` |
| Nebula full-bleed outside hero L2 | Atmosphere is subtle, local |
| `transition-all` | Motion rules |
| Centered stock-photo hero | Spaceman right, copy left |
| White primary CTA (v1) | Use flare-500 |
| Gray kickers (v1) | Use spectral-500 |

## 11. Stitch generation guidance

### 11.1 Language to use

**Dark editorial portfolio**, **mission-control monochrome**, **cyan telemetry kickers**, **gold launch CTAs**, **halftone poster**, **conversion-first specialist**.

### 11.2 Screen generation vs design system

- **Tokens live here** and in project theme — do not repeat hex values in `generate_screen_from_text` prompts
- Generation prompts: describe **layout, section order, copy** only
- **Edit prompts:** may use hex for precise color fixes

### 11.3 Example structure prompt (homepage)

```
Desktop 1280px dark homepage. Section order: nav, hero, trust, work, process, tools, cta, footer.
Hero: full-bleed halftone spaceman right, left column with cyan mono kicker, white display headline,
gray subhead, gold primary button and outline secondary. Trust: gray copy + optional cyan stat row.
Work: one mission card with spectral hover border treatment. Final CTA floating band with gold Book a Call.
Pure black background, no purple gradients, no colored paragraph text.
```

### 11.4 Visual references (Stitch screens)

| Screen | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| Ref — Token Showcase v2 Mission Control | **Primary** token + component visual |
| Ref — Hero Composition Desktop / Mobile | L0 layout |
| Ref — Hero Layer Stack | L0/L2/L3 |
| Ref — Wireframe Homepage | Section order + copy |
| DESIGN.md (this file) | Semantic source of truth |

## 12. Per-page briefs (structure only)

### `/work`

Kicker Mission log · H1 Selected work — portfolios and landing pages that perform. · Grid Option B · CTA band Want results like these?

### `/services`

Kicker Mission packages · Packages £500–1k portfolio, £1k–3k landing · 5-day process · FAQ · CTA band

# Design System: By Jawad — Mission Control Monochrome

**Owner:** Jawad Jalal · Portfolio & Landing Page Specialist  
**Version:** mission-control-monochrome-v2 · **Project ID:** `13841983534348291374`  
**Canonical repo doc:** `docs/design-token-system.md`  
**Visual proof:** `docs/design-token-showcase-v2.html`

**Brand:** Editorial black-and-white core + cyan mission telemetry + gold launch CTAs.  
**3-second emotion:** *"This person is operating at a different level."*  
**Business goal:** Book a Call · Start an Inquiry

---

## 1. Design philosophy

### 1.1 Accent budget (locked)

| Tier | Share | Tokens | Use on | Never use on |
|------|-------|--------|--------|--------------|
| **Ink** | ~85% | ink, neutral, surface, text | Backgrounds, H1–H4, body, nav text, secondary/ghost CTAs, white halftone | — |
| **Spectral** | ~10% | spectral.* | Kickers, active nav underline, focus rings, stat values, card hover border, hero L2 atmosphere | Body copy, headlines, CTA fill |
| **Flare** | ~5% | flare.* | Primary CTA fill only | Kickers, links, headings, decorative blocks |

Semantic colors (success, error, warning, info) are **forms and system feedback only**.

### 1.2 Visual north star

Swiss poster restraint on a **pure black canvas** (`#000000`). Mission-control telemetry reads through **cyan mono kickers** and **stat numerals**. Conversion moments use **gold buttons** with black labels. Depth from **halftone dots**, **film grain**, and **layered neutral surfaces** — not nebula gradients or violet SaaS chrome.

### 1.3 Motion (hard rules)

- Animate **only** `transform` and `opacity`
- Never `transition-all`
- Hover: `duration-150` · Enter: `duration-300` · Easing: see frontmatter `motion`
- Honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` (disable parallax, orbit, marquee)

---

## 6. Halftone, grain & atmosphere

### 6.1 Film grain (global)

| halftone-hero | 8px | white | 12% | overlay | Hero edges (non-spaceman side OK) |
| halftone-spectral | 8px | `#22D3EE` | 8% | overlay | **Hero right edge only** (spaceman side) |
| halftone-image | 6px | white | 10–15% | soft-light | Thumbnail overlays |

Stack on hero scrim layer — not full-site background:

- Project thumbnails: grayscale default, `effect.image-overlay` gradient to top
- Halftone overlay on images for editorial texture
